rules: Only invented brands, products and people.
No real brand names, logos, trademarks, celebrities, politicians or parties: a list and a near-miss check refuse them.
Pharma-style spots sell an invented drug for an invented condition, make no medical claims, and carry a parody card.
Every spot carries an “AI-generated” label for its whole length.
Adults only, fully clothed. Nothing sexual. No alcohol or tobacco: the beer-style genre sells a soda.
Words on screen come from ffmpeg and a font, never from an image model.
